comment: I loved this course. Most of the plays and films were new to me. I learned a lot and enjoyed our conversations.

She can be pretty condescending at times and a very confusing grader. She is incredibly nit picky. Lectures were pretty boring at times. It is very difficult to know what she wants/doesn't want. She is nice person but I would choose another FYS especially if you're not interested in Theater. I did; however, learn a lot. Lots of reading though.

Dr. Feldman is a great professor. You don't really need to read every play, but make sure you have enough information to write your essays. Some people will say she is a tough grader, but I did pretty well. I thought that the subject matter was pretty interesting, and I am not even interested in theater.

Dr. Feldman wasn't great. She is pretty condescending and it's hard to know what she is looking for. She managed to turn a writing course into a theater course, too. She seems like a great person, but her lectures are SO BORING and she is kinda mean when she corrects you.
I loved the class. One of my favorite professors
Great films! Loved the course!
A fun course with a lot of interesting films
Loved the class!
Very helpful outside class.
A lot of reading in Spanish but worth it.
Great class. Very helpful during office hours.
Fun class. I learned a lot.
A lot of reading, but one of the best classes I've talken at UR.
Loved the readings! Great professor!
Great class! Very engaging.
One of my favorite professors. Really cares about students.

Dr. Feldman is a very kind woman if she likes you. The class is taught 100% in Spanish which is very helpful for listening  comprehension however it is easy to get lost. A few essays and 1 test. Lots of homework on basic grammar which is gone over in class. You must participate to do well.
Great professor who really wants you to improve. Show improvement and go to office hours and you'll get a good grade. Effort and participation are key.

Had for FYS Barcelona, M & C. She's obsessed with Catalonia and wishes she was from there. Definitely knows her history and current news. Loved to name-drop peopleplacesbooksnews she knows, has been to or was featured in. Agree with her and seem interested, get on her good side (she plays clear favorites). Overall, easy class and a nice person
Yes, she thinks she's from Spain but really she's from New York. She shows pictures for the entire class period. She is not helpful and is very condescending.

If you have no interest in plays and diving deep into these crazy other meanings for absolutely everything do not take her class. I made that mistake and she always is calling people out who do not talk much in class and if you have no idea how to answer her questions (which was often for me) then you will be called out. Papers were not easy
Great professor!

Dr. Feldman is a very impressive teacher, in my opinion.  She has personally been very help helpful to me as I'm currently studying abroad.  We did an in-class presentation (with a partner), lots of class discussion (fairly open-ended), and a few essay assignments.  Fairly straight-forward, and she is not as hard on grammatical mistakes as others.

I had her for a 300 level, and then for a 400 level class. She's fairly predictable, and not that difficult if you know what she's looking for. If you participate in class and speak to her after class, chances are she'll like you (which you want her to - she plays favorites). Overall, the course itself is not bad and she definitely knows her stuff.
Had her last semester, grades fairly on writing assignments, I'm taking her again for a 321. She loves to take about Cataluna.. and def. thinks she's spanish. awesome teacher regardless
No Comments

Plays favorites extremely.  Always found something to nitpick; only teacher I've ever had who got mad at me for writing more than was asked.  I tried talking to her about my problems, refused to listen.
No Comments
I didn't find the class all that challenging but if you're not interested in hearing all about Catlonia every day, don't take it.
Sharon Feldman was my favorite professor in college.  She was very demanding, yet I learned a tremendous amount from her.
great clothes, not so great of a teacher.  i agree, she does think she's spanish.

My favor prof. Admires int students, ad loves our opinion. I want to thank her for getting me into grad school for Spanish. Made me love the Spanish cult and lang. Very passionate about stories from Barcelona/catalan/. Can be intimidating, and sometimes hard on students while interacting. Yet,she is a very good person inside, if she lets you see it

Good at Spanish.  Bad at teaching.  Bad at life. To be fair, had friends who loved her. She has favorites and I wasn't one. Go talk to her and make her feel loved and you may do better. But she is a bad teacher. Most classes consisted of her showing us pictures of Spain rather than teaching.
No Comments
hates kids in fraternities and thinks she is spanish.  Honestly, she sucks at life.
